reason: We already got burned by Jamku and clunky desktop ERPs that our staff abandoned after two months, so we reverted to Excel and WhatsApp which cost nothing and actually work. I am not paying over ₹20,000 a year for practice management software when free tools do the job and my team will likely stop using another tool anyway.
objection: Why pay over ₹20,000 for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, especially after my staff already abandoned Jamku and desktop ERP after just two months?
would_change_my_mind: Hearing fellow practitioners at my monthly ICAI study circle vouch for it and seeing my staff test the free pilot for 60 days without abandoning it.
